text: I walked in without a prior appointment and I got my registration done for first time, met the doctor, got my blood extracted for testing and done my ECG in less than 2 hours for everything. Service is tip top throughout and although the price is more premium than local hospitals and clinics, you're assured of quality and a wide range of services. They have a Bangkok Plaza beside too for customers to have their meals or family members to get food while visiting in-patients. Thumbs up!👍🏻

Today went to this hospital to get treatment.  Using por ror bor insurance.
Excellent service, hospital handled insurance claim anf were very efficient.
Had 3 nurses and doctor tteating me.
Took about one hour and another hour  to wait fof processing and medications.
Highly recomment.

And the bill was good too. Not overcharged so can get more appointment under max claim cost with por ror bor insurance.

My experience at Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai was nothing short of exceptional.

While traveling in Thailand, I unexpectedly needed emergency medical care — always a stressful situation, especially in a foreign country. From the moment I arrived, the professionalism and efficiency of the hospital staff immediately put me at ease.

The level of care I received was truly impressive. I underwent a comprehensive evaluation that included an ultrasound, a cardiogram (ECG), and a chest X-ray. I was examined by three different doctors, each thorough, attentive, and reassuring. Communication was clear, and the staff spoke excellent English, which made the entire process smooth and comfortable.

What stood out even more was the cost. Without any insurance, the total for this extensive emergency workup came to approximately 200 US dollars. Considering the quality of care, modern facilities, and speed of service, the value was remarkable.

The hospital itself is modern, clean, and extremely well organized — comparable to high-end private medical centers anywhere in the world. There was no sense of chaos or delay, just calm efficiency and genuine patient care.

Travelers often worry about healthcare abroad, but my experience here completely changed that perspective. The combination of high-level medical expertise, excellent service, and reasonable pricing was extraordinary.

I would not hesitate to recommend Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai to anyone traveling in Thailand. It provided peace of mind in a moment when it mattered most.

I had two visits at Bangkok hospital in Chiang Mai.. first outpatient service where I have to get a CT with dye. It went smooth, however the image that I need it is impossible open on Mac computer and they couldn’t give me hard copy. I just waisted 22K for the visit without able to have the CT’s can image that I could send to my physician back home! My second visit to the ER pretty much related to the first visit.I requested MRI, but they were saying “ let’s do other CT scan and ultrasound for abdominal which didn’t show anything. Half day passed in ER they did a few other testing that all come back negative. I asked again for MRI. Finally they told me that the MRI is completely booked for the day. Basically I paid another 15k for unnecessary testing that I know will not helping to find the cause of my severe pain. They should be honest from the begin that the MRI device is booked instead charging me not necessary testing that not related to my pain.The staff is very kind but they are focusing more on making money on patient instead determinate a diagnosis. I also had a cancer bloodwork testing that includes a final consultation with oncologist. However my blood test didn’t come back at time as I was told.I was waiting two months for the test result. I have to leave due the smoke that covered the city. I got my test result finally in email but I couldn’t discuss with the oncologist that was included in the price that I paid.Too much focusing on how they can get more money out of patents pocket without significant care and resolution.This is my opinion as a former healthcare worker from OR department.

We just come here to see a doctor for health advice. So the experience is quite simple.

The hospital has a perfect environment like a 5 -star hotel. Staff, nurse speaks good English. Quick registration procedure, the time to wait for the doctor is not long. Consulting costs are not too expensive.

However, when viewing the price list of CT scans, blood tests, the price is very expensive, our insurance cannot be paid in this hospital. So we returned to the public hospital where insurance paid for testing expenses.

Broken Nose Surgery
I’m sharing this because reviews here are mixed, and my experience was very positive.
After a head injury that caused heavy bleeding and a cut near my eye, I was assessed quickly and given both an X-ray and CT scan. I initially wondered if this was excessive, but the CT revealed multiple fractures — so I’m glad it was done.
I was then seen by a plastic surgeon who clearly explained the results and my options, without pressure. Based on the extent of the damage, she recommended immediate surgery under general anaesthetic. Naturally this was worrying (it’s your face), but everything was explained thoroughly, including risks, which I also independently verified with UK doctors in my family.
The surgery went very well. My nose was realigned with minimal visible scarring once the stitches were removed. Aftercare was excellent, and the room and facilities were very comfortable.
When you’re injured and anxious it’s easy to question timing, tests, or communication — I did at first. But with hindsight, the care was professional, thorough, and genuinely reassuring.
If you have insurance, I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this hospital.

I had an emergency injury and was weary of coming here because of the bad reviews; it's the only hospital in my insurance network. So far my experience has been great.

The staff at the ENT center are very good and sweet. I had surgery in a state of the art facility which went very well. The cost is pretty steep, but the hospital departments worked fairly quickly with my insurance to get everything paid for.

I can't speak for the hospital as a whole, but if you have ear, nose and throat issues (and travel insurance) or are in need of emergency surgery, then you should be in good hands.

This was by far the best healthcare I’ve ever received! I rushed my son to the ER because while jumping on the trampoline, he fell and his tooth punctured his tongue. The care was out of this world, nothing like I’d experienced in America! …

The environment is very nice, but the customer service and waiting time is super long. If a patient rush not recommended to come. If have more time would be ok.
My appointment time is 9:30 am, I came before that time, and waiting in the waiting room, I just realized that a lot of patients who coming after me they’ve already checked, so I went to the counter and ask them, just answered me “please queue” with inpatient sound, then I wait another 10 minutes not calling me. So I just ask them I cannot wait, I will cancel it. Then they did it for me check up right away. I’d apologized them not because I’m angry, just because I’m on time and  feeling discriminating among the other patients, even I’d made the appointment and arrived on time.

I visited this hospital through insurance. And still feel like I was scammed.
I had a toothache. I had medical examination and x-ray. In ordinary clinic the cost of it is about 500 THB, I checked. They gave me invoice for 1800 THB. Ok, it’s the price of this clinic. But for my insurance they converted this invoice with their own rate and 1800 THB became $100! It’s 40% fee, insane. Never recommend this clinic, only if you have unlimited budget.

I would like to share my experience at the Hematology-Oncology department. Unfortunately, the nurse wearing red glasses was very rude and did not treat me with respect. I felt very uncomfortable and disappointed with her attitude.

However, I would like to mention that the service in other departments met the standard and was professional. I hope the hospital takes this feedback seriously and improves the behavior of staff to ensure all patients are treated with kindness and respect.

After a fall, we needed hospital care and contacted two hospitals. One was unhelpful, but this hospital immediately told us to come in with no issues.

Zero waiting time my father was seen straight away. Following the consultation, he was given pain relief before undergoing an X-ray, which confirmed broken ribs. The doctors recommended 24-hour observation as a precaution for any underlying issues. Everything was clearly explained and he was admitted immediately. The entire process took under two hours.

We were extremely impressed with the hospital’s standards, cleanliness, and the professionalism of the staff. The room was excellent, complete with Netflix and room service. Every nurse knew my father by name and had a clear treatment and pain-management plan in place, including medications prepared and ready for discharge. The level of organisation was outstanding.

Pricing was also very reasonable. Easily the best hospital experience we’ve had anywhere in the world, and we’ve been to more than a few. Would definitely recommend.

Once, never again. The service is nice and the staffs are kind definitely but the attitude of the 1 specific doctor. Im in distress already because of pain and got laughed at when i’m trying to explain how i feel. Instead of her helping me diagnose and recommend what should be the next step since she can’t diagnose shit for me. Just tell me to go home and rest and find another doctor??

Reception and medical counter services were excellent, and the facilities are very luxurious. However, my consultation experience was disappointing. While explaining my medical history, the assistant repeatedly interrupted me, which felt rude and uncomfortable. More concerning was the physician’s examination practice. The doctor did not wear gloves and had long fingernails, which caused significant pain during the physical examination. Even after I mentioned the pain, the examination continued. Later, when the swelling reduced, I noticed clear nail marks left on my skin.
As a paying patient, I expect professional communication and proper hygiene standards. This experience was upsetting and needs improvement.

After 33 hours of traveling from California I ended up having to go to the hospital in the middle of the night.  Im from america so, you know, we have slow medical service.   I was very happy to get seen right away here.  I mean as soon as …

Highly overpriced and lacking transparency. If you’re paying out of pocket, please be cautious. The staff kind but were not always upfront about the total costs, and I didn’t realize how quickly the bill was adding up until I reached the cashier. I ended up paying roughly $300 USD for consultation and exams, but what upset me the most was the $300 USD for a medication that I later found at a local pharmacy for only $45 USD. I wish they had discussed cost-effective options with me -- they didn’t. I came in for a check on my heart condition, but the price tag for their service and medication alone could have given me a heart attack. Absolutely regret coming here. If you don't have insurance, do not buy medication from here and just get the prescription and buy somewhere else.

text: I used the services at the psychiatric department. The doctor recommended a psychotherapist. I changed to a third one. It was because the psychotherapist kept changing. The psychiatrist has to follow the psychotherapist who come to work at the hospital. The patient had to keep starting over which is not proper for the treatment. The treatment cost was not cheap. I have to change hospital and doctor.  Very disappointed as the atmosphere was nice.

Clean facility and polite staff, but the ER communication was frustrating. I waited a long time for a doctor to explain my situation. My Thai friend was communicating with staff in Thai, and I can speak English, but it seemed they were trying to arrange a translator without checking with me first. This caused avoidable delays and stress.

My bf and I came here for a check-up and was disappointed with the experience. Despite confirming via Line beforehand, they forgot to register me entirely. We had a 10am appointment but ended up waiting over an hour with no clear communication.

The biggest issue was the disorganization. Unlike other hospitals, there was no single assigned nurse - we were just constantly told to "go wait there". After fasting for 4+ hours as required, we finally went to grab food, only to be urgently called back because "the doctor is waiting." We rushed back without eating, then waited again anyway.

When we finally saw the doctor, they had us both in the room at the same time instead of seeing us separately. I also expected to see specialists for a comprehensive check-up, not just one general doctor. The staff and doctor were friendly and nice, but the service quality simply doesn't match the cost. Would not recommend.

I really thought this would be a better hospital as compared to the public ones. Considering the price you pay, you would expect a premium systematic process. I came in and was told that the doctor is ready to see me right away. I waited two hours until I was actually seen by her. Apparently, the nurses have overseen my files. I had to come up repeatedly to ask for an update only to know that they forgot I was waiting.

The worst here is that you would get random nurses attend to you who doesn’t seem to connect with each other. I had submitted my result to one nurse who didn’t tell the others so my turn kept getting pushed back.

Now on my 4th hour waiting.

Honestly, not worth the extra fee for a fake “premium”. There are better hospitals in Chiang Mai.

Due an accident on my bicycle I had to go to the hospital. Hip replacement and also operation on shoulder. Doctor very high skill and caring. All nurses excellent help and always with a smile. People responsible for food also great and food great taste every day.
A chrash like this can make you start thinking and  get sad and depressed but the way how every member of this hospital acting, the care they show and always close to laugh and big smile make me feel so much better during my 3 weeks stay.
Thank you all for you caring about me.
Farang at room 502

Very unsatisfactory medical experience！
We went to the emergency room yesterday and were given an appointment with a dentist for today. …

Very clean hospital. Good for tourists. Doctors speak English. If you have direct billing they can charge to your insurance. If you don’t it may get expensive.

X-Ray, doctor, IV, medicine, 2 hours there was about 4000 baht. $160 CAD in 2018. Pricing depends on what the specialist says, tests and time of day.

Nicest hospital I’ve been to. It’s private, so you’re paying for better care.

text: The process here was very quick, my appointment was at 10 o clock, I showed up at 9:40 and was guided at every step by staff members, I then got my medication by 10:30. I booked the appointment online and emailing the hospital has been very efficient, their response times have been quick and they have been very helpful. I came here early on a Wednesday morning, so perhaps waiting times will vary depending on time and date, but I personally have had a very lovely experience. I had gone to Sriphat Hospital previously and had a bad experience there, it is safe to say I will be sticking to this hospital from now on.

If you are foreigner and have medical emergency I would definitely recommend coming to this hospital.

I walked into emergency with bad chest pains possible heart attack and within minutes of hearing my description of the pain they took me into emergency room. Started testing and verified I was having acute heart attacks need the surgery right away.
Because I did not have insurance I did need to verify I had means to pay for the full operation. Luckily it was fraction of cost compared to US hospital, which I paid with credit cards.
After the surgery I was relocated to patient room for 2 nights observation which was very nice single room for myself.
Doctors spoke excellent English and most of staff was very friendly/ helpful. The hospital seemed to cater to foreigners.

Bewildering incompetence.

Waited for more than an hour for a simple, routine yearly flu vaccine (which …

The hospital appears modern but is also very inefficient. We had an appointment with a clear purpose but were sent between various unnecessary doctors and had to wait way more than 4 hours. I'd rather have an efficient treatment than a piano in the lobby...

I accompanied a breast cancer patient through treatment at this hospital.
Despite its “international” image, our experience was deeply disappointing.

Key decisions were made with poor communication between surgeons, oncologists, and radiotherapy teams. Important risks (including surgical margin issues) were not clearly explained, and responsibility was shifted between departments.

Treatment followed a very aggressive, one-size-fits-all approach, even for an elderly ER/PR-positive patient. When chemotherapy had to stop due to toxicity, the patient was strongly pressured to take extremely expensive medication instead. Multiple oncologists later consulted overseas did not support this recommendation.

Follow-up testing and add-on investigations felt excessive, costly, and poorly justified. Explanations were mostly verbal, with little written information, leaving patients anxious and confused.

Modern facilities alone do not equal ethical, patient-centred care.
I strongly recommend seeking independent second opinions before starting treatment here.

First class treatment from the orthopedic team.
Thank you very much for your professionalism.
Definitely recommend.

This is the best international in Chiang Mai , this hospital take care with good service mild and high medical technology , doctor and all staff was so nice , smile , polite , the price of this hospital reasonable with the good service good medicine. This hospital also have translator in all languages by phone and have many staff can speak other language , so you don’t worry about communication.

Had a wonderful experience with the lactation nurse in the OBGYN clinic. Would recommend to other breast feeding moms who need help when visiting chiang mai. Also is a very nice facility and food court is awesome.

It’s worse than a general hospital. Waiting 2h just because doctor only comes at 5 pm. They told me to see plastic surgeon for a small wound instead of general surgeon. What kind of scam is this? Nurse to whom I talked showed high disrespect and anxiety after I said I need a general surgeon. Feels like you’re getting paid, not them.

The hospital has expanded the space and has nice atmosphere with a free coffee machine. They have good doctors but the waiting time is too long. I made appointment at 11.15 am but I met a doctor at 12.15. then the doctor assigned for x-ray. It was quick but then we had to wait for the doctor again until 1.15 pm. Every process had at least 30 mins waiting time. We left the hospital at 2 pm.  it was too long for waiting at this hospital.

Unreal experience, first thai hospital experience 10/10. In and out in 2 hours for a procedure I’ve needed done for 4-5 years that Australian medical system beat around the bush trying to avoid to do other things that don’t work!

Pretty good hospital. Nice and clean. Doctors here are similar to doctors at other local hospitals.  Nice clean rooms.  Prices  at bangkok hospital continue to rise and and this hospital is no longer a good deal.  Doctors can speak good english.  The staff can speak some english.

I called Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai for some information and was told the nurse would call me back because she was busy. The call never came. Very unprofessional. Most of the comments speak for themselves. Had even a bad messed up surgery at Bangkok Hospital Pattaya many years ago. The doctor cut my nerve. No sensation in that part ever since.
It most certainly depends on for what you come here. These are the departments I can judge from my personal experience so far: …

I went to this hospital due to poisoning, as later revealed, caused by rotavirus and e. coli. Medical staff took care of me immedietaly.

During my 5 day stay at the hospital, I  received great care from highly professional and engaged team of nurses.

The building is very modern and tidy. My room was cleaned and supplied with different amenities daily.

Went for cardiac assessment — not emergency care. I was able to easily book an appointment online and receive confirmation for a visit for the following day. I selected the assessment that I wanted but was able to review my request with a cardiologist before the testing. She reviewed my symptoms and agreed for the need for testing. I completed an extensive amount of test (blood test, UA, stress test, ECG) within a few hours and had the results. The cardiologist reviewed the findings with me. I am very grateful and impressed with the care received here.
The dermatologist was very patient, professional and I felt well looked after throughout!

I came here because we expected a tropical infection .. The way they take care of you kinda blowed my mind … Everything was coordinated and fast . They took care that all of my doctors and nurses are speaking English . The treatment was …

1.)Easy to find the location it’s on the superhighway Chiangmai-Lampang near Makro.
2.) They really care to service you.
3.)The doctors can speak English pretty well.
4.)Inside of building it has many ATMs , the coffee shop the drug store.
5.) It’s clean place and  nice looking.
6.) The price it’s same as other private hospitals in Chiangmai same range.
I think it’s a great choice for hospital.

I visited this hospital today to get some bloodwork done. The blood needed to be taken before 10am for the results to be accurate. I arrived before the department opened at 8am. Despite knowing that my blood needed to be taken before 10am, …

I needed emergency care and received excellent service! A consultation, including an exam and medication at the end, cost a little over 1000 Baht. I was admitted immidiately due to food poisoning. All the doctors and nurses were super nice and supportive. All support was provided in English. I highly recommend it to foreigners!

The best (and most expensive) western style hospital in Chiang Mai with English speaking doctors and staff. There may be better specialists or specialty departments at other hospitals,  but this would be a good starting point for diagnostics.

Dr. was super careless and prescribed my husband cipro for a very common bacterial infection.

We did our own research into the antibiotics that the doctor prescribed just as a precaution and found that cipro has caused many many people irreversible side effects such as depression, nerve damage, and so many more terrible things. Just for a simple infection she prescribed him cipro!

Worst part was we got zero warning about side effects from doctor or pharmacist. So irresponsible I cannot believe it!

Beware of this hospital. I had a bad case of gastroenteritis...with their recommendation to have a CAT scan and blood test...totalling 40000 thb. Although covered by insurance, I questioned why? No valid response was received from the young and inexperienced doctor except I should also stay in overnight for observation (which I assumed would be very expensive). I declined and sort medical advice from HCMC medical practice..who gave me a diagnosis and medication...all for 1320 thb...I was well on the road to recovery the next morning. In short...it's an insurance scam by the hospital to advise you on treatments you probably do not require...just for profit. I will never set foot in this hospital again.

text:
Disappointing Experience with Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai

I recently had an unfortunate experience at Bangkok Hospital in Chiang Mai, and …
This place has zero customer support. Can't even book an appointment because they don't respond to any emails or inquiries on their website. Chiang Mai Ram at least responds pretty fast.

I have never felt so ripped off in my entire life across nine countries. Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai is, in my opinion, the last hospital a foreigner should consider in Chiang Mai. You will be charged exorbitantly for mediocre service.

They charged 3,500 THB for medicine worth around 900 THB, leveraging my distress to extract a 160% overcharge. The bill even included a 200 THB fee just for putting my medicine in a bag... I am not joking.

The nurse barely spoke English and tried to push unnecessary extra appointments and tests.

The doctor was 25 minutes late, despite his department being empty, gave me 4 minutes of consultation, went back to doing nothing, and charged 950 THB. Completely useless and predatory. He cares so much about his patients than in spite of this being my third visit he still didn't know my name and I doubt he recognizes me.

The second floor had litter around, and I tripped on sticky Starbucks coffee. They can’t even keep their premises clean.

Staff are rude, obsessed by getting as much possible money as they can from you, and clearly don’t care about patient health. Cashier straight asked me " How much cash do you have on you"'?. I was bewildered. Last time I I heard that sentence I was getting mugged, not in an institution that is supposedly reputable.

But hey, there’s a guy playing piano in the lobby, so I guess that makes their circus “classy” and “high-end”?

This is the worst hospital experience I have ever had. Avoid at all costs.

Check in @Emergency and stayed overnight for surgery.
Bangkok Hospital Chiang mai has impressed us with their excellent service and attention to details.

I think the hospital is slipping or they are understaffed. I came in for an ultrasound to see my stomach muscles, the radiologist did not do an ultrasound for that, the doctor took a week to get back to me to tell me that I needed to come …

First class hospital if you’re willing to spend a little more.
Spotless, modern with a very competent and helpful staff. They had all the newest equipment including a GE CT scanner, Hill-Rom transport gurneys and beds and modern laparoscopic diagnosis and surgical equipment. A shout out to Dr. Worawit K. who came to the emergency room in the middle of the night and was a thorough professional throughout!
The initial estimate scared me a bit but at the end, they actually came in well below estimate.

Patients -BEWARE- This has to be the worst hospital in Chaingmai. Yes the rooms are beautiful,  they even have battery operated trash cans.
However if your sick Do Not …

I went to the gynecology department for an ultrasound and other checkups. The hospital itself is clean, organized and comfortable. Most of the staff we interacted with could speak English. The service was quite good, and the doctor was very friendly and helpful! It made us feel at ease. An ultrasound by itself costed 2900 baht. If you drive and park at the parking there is even a shuttle service that will take you to the entrance of the hospital and back when you’re done.

Fantastic service and very good quality, with everyone speaking English.

The doctor was excellent, very courteous and professional. Explaining everything …

Efficient and friendly service, from welcome to accompaniment between paperwork and medical procedures. Prices are reasonable. My doctor was very understanding not only of my medical situation but also my financial concerns regarding treatment. Bangkok Hospital even provides free shuttle to help with transportation accessibility!

I visited the hospital specifically to see a particular doctor with whom I had scheduled an appointment. However, at the last moment, it turned out that a different doctor was assigned to me. No one informed me about this change in advance. I was simply led into the office, where I found out that the specialist was someone else.
Additionally, when I clarified the cost of services before my visit, I explicitly asked whether the doctor’s consultation was included in the package with the ultrasound, and I was told “yes.” In reality, it was not included. This is misleading information. Had I known that the package only covered the ultrasound and not the consultation, I would have chosen not to proceed with the ultrasound.
Furthermore, I don’t understand why medications were added to my bill without my consent. When I refused to pay for them, I wasn’t even given a proper prescription. I was only allowed to take a photo of it. If I am paying for a consultation, I believe I have the right to receive a proper prescription.

My partner and I went to get a consultation with the skin clinic. We rang first and were told there was no fee for this but after the consultation we were told we had to pay 800 baht each. I asked if this would come off the fee for the …

The hospital looks modern and advanced. The staff was courteous and helpful. Wait time was not too long and the doctor was knowledgeable. Most importantly, the price for foreigners (consultation only) was affordable.

The hospital is great ! I didn’t feel good at night and went for the check up. The nurse, the doctor and other staff were very friendly and explained to me everything in details in friendly manner. I paid around 1100 baht. Thanks for your help 🙏 …

My daughter came here for abdominal pains on a Monday. They did a complete exam including an ultrasound, a CT scan and bloodwork. They discovered she had a tumor on her ovary. The doctor wanted to do surgery right away. She scheduled the surgery for Wednesday. I flew here from America so I could be with her. The surgery went great and she spent two days in the hospital recovering. Obviously coming from America I was nervous about the whole situation. But from start to finish, I couldn’t have asked for better care. From the Doctors to the nurses I couldn’t be more happy.

text: What it was supposed to be a new carpark with proper shade . Turned out  the roof is leaking . Not only that , it was flooded that it was hard to get into the car.   Bad engineering from 5 star hospital.

My experience with Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai was beyond disappointing; it was genuinely distressing and felt like a calculated attempt to make money by scaring patients. I would strongly advise anyone, especially foreigners or students …

My experience as a walk-in with minor injuries (road rash wounds & knee ligament damage from a bike accident), was top class 🙏 from the moment I got out of the taxi a porter was coming with a wheelchair to assist me. I was quickly assessed and then wheeled to the correct department where I was triaged and didn't have to wait long to see a doctor. It wasn't long again before I had an x-ray and again, a short wait until the results. Nothing was too much as they wheeled me and waited for two toilet visits and a cafe run (a very minimalist coffee/snack cafe in the hospital).
The most note-worthy was my experience with a young female doctor and her assistant nurse. They were both so friendly and kindly spoke great English. They could see that gauze was stuck in my wounds from a previous treatment at a lesser establishment, and they were so delicate and gentle when removing them, constantly apologising and making sure I was ok! I'm from the UK and have never had a doctor spend time doing something like this, usually a nurse who is overworked and has to rush through. Their follow-up care and attention to detail with little gift-style hospital bags for prescriptions is a really nice touch. They have free water cups everywhere; high, wing-back comfy chairs; relaxing grand piano playing; high ceilings; large windows; plenty of light; modern interior and very friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Not very busy, just a nice steady pace. A very redemptive experience for me after some traumas in hospitals before.
I am Indian living at San kamphaeng in Chiang Mai. I   went there for annual health check-up and it was great experience. …

good and friendly service at a high cost. it cost the same as places like Singapore. cost is very high for simple infections and running tests on a few machines will cost you a few hundred dollars. it is a luxury healthcare hospital for specific cliente. I went there as I was sick and it was the nearest. i don't think the high cost justifies the value of the treatments. Some surgeries may be quoted at a price of a car. Doctors' service vary as well, some friendly and some not so much. Nurses are always friendly.

I’ve been coming to Chiang Mai for many years. From my (fortunately small) local hospital experience, I find this to be the best hospital for a foreign traveler in need. The costs are quite high, but generally not higher than in other …

Excellent experience.

Very professional. Fast. Organized.

I hope you never need to go to the hospital and stay healthy, but if you have a health concern, then yes, without hesitation. The patient journey is streamlined and the doctor is very professional.
It's a hospital with good service.

Absolutely great experience, very professional and nice english speaking staff.
quick service as well.

A horrific, shameful, and deeply unethical experience!

My husband was brought to Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai with a high fever of 38.7°C, severe weakness, and chronic asthma. We spent more than TWO HOURS in this hospital, and they did ABSOLUTELY NOTHING to help a vulnerable, suffering patient. They didn't even bother to take a basic blood test to check his infection markers or hydration levels!

Instead, the staff spent the entire time aggressively pressuring us to sign overnight inpatient admission papers and demanding a massive 30,000 THB deposit upfront. They literally refused to provide emergency medical care without this cash payment, completely ignoring my husband’s deteriorating state and high-risk respiratory condition. This is pure financial extortion, not healthcare. Even the doctor eventually admitted that the insurance department was blocking everything and suggested we leave for another hospital.

To make this nightmare even worse, after failing to provide any medical assistance, they forced us to stand in a long queue at the 'Hospital Pharmacy' for absolutely no reason, and then sent us to wait in another terrible, slow queue just to pay the basic doctor's fee before we could leave! Total chaos, bureaucracy, and absolute disrespect for human life.

If you are a tourist or an expat with international insurance, avoid this place at all costs. They only care about your wallet, not your health. A total disgrace to the medical profession.

text:
My experience at Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai is:

1. The doctors are very childish. When giving advice, they don't offer reasonable recommendations. If they see you can afford it, they'll recommend extreme packages, making you spend more than necessary. It felt more like a cosmetic clinic selling hard-sell courses than genuine sincerity and the doctors' genuine concern for your health.

2. The hospital emphasizes comprehensive and modern equipment, and offers coffee and water, which is presumably included in the fee.

3. The follow-up system is terrible. Despite paying a high price, test results are slow to come out. The hospital tells you to check your email, with no notification system via Line or WhatsApp. Patients living abroad need to be prepared for this.

I've never waited in line this long before, and it's truly disappointing. I arrived at 12:30 PM, and now it's 2:30 PM, and I still haven't seen a doctor. The nurses just keep coming in and apologizing for the wait and asking if I could wait another 15 minutes. I waited another 30 minutes, and still no one called me.
In the end, I had to leave. In summary, I gained absolutely nothing today; I wasted 2.5 hours of my life.
For others, 2.5 hours of waiting might be normal, but for me, every moment in life has a price. I feel terrible.

Cannot detail our experience here due to defamation laws.  I cannot recommend enough Chiang Mai RAM hospital which I've only had A+ experience with for more than ten years.  I visited Bangkok Hospital in CM two times and that was more than enough.  I'll drive the extra distance to RAM for quality service.  Even if bleeding out, I'll go to RAM instead of this place.

Giving it one star is a tough decision. I've been receiving treatment for a while and only just had time to write a review… The wait was incredibly long. My mother had an abscess on her back. We waited 40 minutes for the doctor to examine her, then almost an hour for a price assessment. After agreeing to the procedure, they took her to a minor surgery room and made her wait for almost another hour until she was freezing. She couldn't bear the wait any longer because the doctor was examining other patients! What kind of service is this?! We paid almost 17,000 baht. The service was terrible. My mother is 76 years old, and they made her wait that long. I will never come back here again. Terrible, terrible service!

I had an emergency appendix surgery here. All processes, surgery, treatment, insurance consultation etc have been flawless and professional. The staff is kind, understanding and cheerful. Had a great time (for the circumstance of being in a hospital...)

text: The doctors here will find all sorts of ways to increase your spending; a small problem can be blown out of proportion, like a rabies vaccination and immunoglobulin injection costing 10,356 Thai Baht.

I came in with abdominal pain and was hospitalized overnight. I filed an insurance claim and was told it would be ready around 4 PM, but it's past that time now and I still haven't been discharged. I don't know how they work; it's incredibly slow and I've wasted the whole day.
I received treatment there. The staff were friendly and efficient. The doctor provided excellent care and followed up on my condition regularly.

Every time I come to the pediatrics department, the wait time to see a doctor is extremely long, even though there aren't many sick children. I wish the hospital would improve this. Today I've been waiting for almost an hour and still haven't seen a doctor, and I don't know when I will.

For the past 2 years I've gone to the Bangkok Hospital in Bangkok for my annual checkup.  This year I noticed that the package I would normally get was just a bit different at the Chiang Mai location, and those differences made it more suitable for me.  Chiang Mai is also closer to where I live.

I was totally impressed with the facilities.  With a new building added and the original site renovated, this is a super modern facility.  Some of the equipment were things I've never seen before.

Staff are excellent.  There's an obvious high degree of training, and they're also nice people.  The hospital also has a "plaza" as in Bangkok, but it was not all fast food.  There is a food court with Thai offerings, a sit down Japanese, and a Starbucks.

I did have to wait a bit longer than previously for my final consultation with Doctor Vatanapunpituk, but in the end I had a much longer and more in depth consultation than in either of my earlier checkups.  The doctor not only reviewed everything, but spent time explaining what it all meant and what I needed to do next.

I had my treatment at the Skin and Aesthetic Clinic at Bangkok Hospital with Dr. Kulwadee, and I’m truly so grateful for the care I received.

Dr. Kulwadee is incredibly professional, gentle, and genuinely kind. You can truly feel that she cares about her patients and treats people with heart. She made me feel comfortable, safe, and well taken care of throughout the entire process.
The staff and nurses were also amazing and super friendly, attentive, and very welcoming. The overall service was excellent from start to finish.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for high-quality treatments with truly compassionate care.

I can accept a higher price, but I can't accept being tricked.

I commend the doctors and nurses; their skills and attitudes were excellent.

However, the customer service representatives who spoke Chinese and the cashier were clearly trying to scam me, which made me feel uncomfortable.

I've heard that Bangkok Hospital is one of the top hospitals in Thailand, and this kind of tricky pricing is somewhat damaging to its image.

They charge you for many things, you did not ask for, so the bill gets a lot higher than you expect. Refuse to pay for those items, that seem ridiculous. Also, buy the medication outside the hospital. They have good facilities, and quality seems ok otherwise.

If you want to experience the service, feel free to try it. But if you want to see a doctor, forget it. My stomach was killing me. In other hospitals, an ultrasound was enough to check for appendicitis or something similar. But here, they insisted on a CT scan. Fine, I have medical insurance. I'm not afraid of you charging me around 39,500 yuan for a CT scan. What angered me the most was that I was the only one getting the CT scan, and they made me wait for three hours. That was while I was writhing in pain. What good is having a nurse push me around during that time? And what's even more absurd is that after my test results came back, the doctor was still asking me questions that had nothing to do with my condition. Then he told me to wait until the specialist was on duty the next day to see me. I was stunned. The test results were already out: lymphadenitis, something that can be treated with antibiotics. I've been in pain here for four or five hours, and you're telling me the doctor is off duty and I have to wait until the doctor is on duty the next day. At first, he said he wasn't a specialist and couldn't prescribe any medication, but after I got angry, he was able to prescribe the right medication. Fine, you charge ten times more than other hospitals, but I need the quality of service I receive. Later, I went to another hospital for a CT scan. Even with a long queue, the results came out in twenty minutes. Compared to the Bangkok hospital where I was the only one getting a CT scan, it took three hours to get the results, which made me even more dissatisfied. For the same CT scan, you charge ten times more and are ten times slower. What's the point of coming here for treatment?

There are in generally very good doctors in the hospital, especially Dr. Thachawud, Dr. Plach, Dr. Teerechat and Dr. Atikun deserve 5 Stars. They are very, very competent and i trust them 100%, also the nurses in the ICU I rate with 5 stars. But the nurses upstairs in the bedroom, especially the ward nurses i must rate with 3 stars. They don't like to hear anything about suffering or pain. The soft blue dressed nurses i can rate with 4 stars. For the Physiotherapists 3 stars except khun Bier 5 stars. The meal is okay but often I get it first when it was cold.

I was a little worried because the hospital's rating on Google Maps was somewhat low, but the doctors and hospital staff were wonderful, and I was very satisfied with the hospital's medical facilities. …

I feel like this hospital is all about getting your money.

They will tell you that specialist doctors are available, and then send a nurse to check on you, tell you that they don't have enough experience and tell you to come back when the specialist is there, and then still charge you money.

During COVID they would place people who were suspected of having COVID among people who did not have COVID. Even when told that is wasn't a good idea.

However, when you do get to see their real specialists, they are good, I just don't think I can recommend it with so many other good hospitals around with much better pricing.
